title: Initialization Scripts for Agents — Why Initialise
titleKn: Agents ಗಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭ Scripts — ಆರಂಭ ಏಕೆ
desc: A script that prepares the environment removes guesswork at the start of every session.
objectives: Explain the value of a repeatable setup.

title: Initialization Scripts for Agents — Idempotent and Fast
titleKn: Agents ಗಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭ Scripts — Idempotent ಮತ್ತು ವೇಗ
desc: A good init script is safe to run repeatedly and fails loudly.
